*   Some dictionaries and many older grammars put _several_ into the word class 'pronoun' in many of its uses.

*   To some speakers, _several_ means "more than one but not very many"; to some others, it means "more than two but not very many." The sole difference is whether two things count as _several_, when the counting is not precise (especially in situations where it may change at any instant, such as _several birds in the yard_).
A similar variability likewise applies to _a few_, as well as _a couple of_ versus _a couple of_.
